title_zh: ComposioHQ 的精选 Claude 技能列表

paragraphs.en: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
paragraphs.zh: 一份精选的优质 Claude Skills、资源和工具列表，用于定制 Claude AI 工作流

paragraphs.en: A comprehensive and curated list of 1000+ production ready and practical Claude Skills and Plugins for enhancing productivity across usecases on not just Claude.ai, Claude Code, but also across coding agents like Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more.
paragraphs.zh: 一份全面且精心整理的列表，包含 1000+ 个可用于生产环境且实用的 Claude 技能与插件，用于提升各类使用场景下的生产力——不仅适用于 Claude.ai 和 Claude Code，还适用于 Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Antigravity 等各类编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: Skills tell your agent how to work. An MCP Gateway gives it secure access to the tools it needs.
paragraphs.zh: 技能告诉你的智能体如何工作。 MCP 网关为它提供对其所需工具的安全访问。

paragraphs.en: Claude Skills are reusable instruction packages that teach an AI agent how to handle a specific class of tasks. Each skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter (name, description) and Markdown instructions, optionally bundled with scripts, references, and assets. Anthropic introduced the format in October 2025 and released it as an open standard in December 2025; it's now supported by Claude Code, Claude.ai, the Claude API, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and Windsurf.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Skills 是可复用的指令包，用于教会一个智能体如何处理某一类特定任务。 每个技能是一个文件夹，其中包含一个带有 YAML frontmatter（name、description）和 Markdown 指令的 SKILL.md 文件，还可以选择性地附带脚本、参考资料和资源。 Anthropic 于 2025 年 10 月推出该格式，并于 2025 年 12 月将其作为开放标准发布；目前 Claude Code、Claude.ai、Claude API、OpenAI Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Antigravity 和 Windsurf 均已支持该格式。

paragraphs.en: Skills load progressively. At session start, the agent sees only each skill's name and description — roughly 100 tokens per skill. The full SKILL.md body (typically under 5,000 tokens) loads only when the agent decides the skill is relevant to the current task. Auxiliary files in scripts/ and references/ load on demand. This is what lets a single agent host hundreds of skills without bloating its context window.
paragraphs.zh: 技能采用渐进式加载。 会话开始时，智能体只能看到每个技能的名称和描述——每个技能大约 100 个 token。 完整的 SKILL.md 正文（通常少于 5,000 个 token）只有在智能体判断该技能与当前任务相关时才会加载。 scripts/ 和 references/ 中的辅助文件按需加载。 正是这一点让单个智能体能够承载数百个技能，而不会撑爆其上下文窗口。

paragraphs.en: Skills are not MCP servers and not tools. MCP defines how an agent connects to external systems — auth, transport, tool discovery. Tools are the individual functions an agent invokes. Skills define the workflow — what to do, in what order, with what guardrails — once the agent has the connections and tools it needs. In production, all three layers run together: MCP for access, tools for actions, skills for behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 技能不是 MCP 服务器，也不是工具。 MCP 定义智能体如何连接到外部系统——认证、传输、工具发现。 工具是智能体调用的单个函数。 技能定义的是工作流——智能体在拥有所需的连接和工具之后，做什么、按什么顺序做、有哪些防护措施。 在生产环境中，这三层是一起运行的：MCP 负责访问，工具负责操作，技能负责行为。

paragraphs.en: Place the skill in ~/.config/claude-code/skills/ :
paragraphs.zh: 将技能放置在 ~/.config/claude-code/skills/ 目录下：

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p ~ /.config/claude-code/skills/ cp -r skill-name ~ /.config/claude-code/skills/ Verify skill metadata:
paragraphs.zh:
mkdir -p ~/.config/claude-code/skills/
cp -r skill-name ~/.config/claude-code/skills/
验证智能体元数据：

paragraphs.en: head ~ /.config/claude-code/skills/skill-name/SKILL.md Start Claude Code:
paragraphs.zh: head ~ /.config/claude-code/skills/skill-name/SKILL.md Start Claude Code:

paragraphs.en: claude The skill loads automatically and activates when relevant.
paragraphs.zh: claude 该技能会自动加载，并在相关时激活。

paragraphs.en: Use the Claude Skills API to programmatically load and manage skills:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Claude Skills API 以编程方式加载和管理技能：

paragraphs.en: import anthropic client = anthropic . Anthropic ( api_key = "your-api-key" ) response = client . messages . create ( model = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022" , skills = [ "skill-id-here" ], messages = [{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "Your prompt" }] ) See the Skills API documentation for details.
paragraphs.zh: 导入 anthropic 客户端 = anthropic 。 Anthropic ( api_key = "your-api-key" ) response = client . messages . create ( model = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022" , skills = [ "skill-id-here" ], messages = [{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "你的提示词" }] ) 详情请参阅 Skills API 文档。

paragraphs.en: Each skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter:
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能都是一个文件夹，其中包含一个带有 YAML frontmatter 的 SKILL.md 文件：

paragraphs.en: skill-name/ ├── SKILL.md # Required: Skill instructions and metadata ├── scripts/ # Optional: Helper scripts ├── templates/ # Optional: Document templates └── resources/ # Optional: Reference files Basic Skill Template --- name : my-skill-name description : A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it. --- # My Skill Name Detailed description of the skill's purpose and capabilities. ## When to Use This Skill - Use case 1 - Use case 2 - Use case 3 ## Instructions [ Detailed instructions for Claude on how to execute this skill ] ## Examples [ Real-world examples showing the skill in action ] Skill Best Practices Focus on specific, repeatable tasks Include clear examples and edge cases Write instructions for Claude, not end users Test across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and API Document prerequisites and dependencies Include error handling guidance Contributing We welcome contributions! Please read our Contributing Guidelines for details on:
